## LKQ Corporation Announces New Leadership Appointment


November 16, 2026


ANTIOCH, Tenn., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LKQ Corporation (Nasdaq: LKQ) today announced that John Meyne, the Company’s current Senior Vice President and President of its North America segment, has decided to retire as of December 31, 2026. The Company’s Board of Directors (the “Board”) has appointed Paul Shaw, currently the Senior Vice President of Operations of LKQ’s North America segment, to succeed Mr. Meyne effective January 1, 2027.


“Paul has dedicated more than 25 years to LKQ, and his contributions have been instrumental in driving the growth of our North America segment. This well-deserved promotion reflects the confidence that our Board, senior management, and customers have in him,” said Mr. Meyne.


Sal Abbate, LKQ’s President and Chief Executive Officer, commented: “We are pleased to announce Paul’s appointment as Senior Vice President of LKQ and President of North America. Paul has a proven track record of implementing operational discipline, deep industry expertise and a lasting commitment to our teams and customers. The Board is confident that, under Paul’s leadership, North America is well positioned to deliver continued value for our customers and shareholders.”


John Mendel, Chairman of the Board, added: “Mr. Meyne has been a trusted partner and an integral part of LKQ’s success. On behalf of the Board, I want to thank him for his dedication and the many contributions he has made to the Company. We wish him all the best in his retirement.”


**About Paul Shaw**


Mr. Shaw has been in our industry for over 35 years and an LKQ team member since 1999 when LKQ acquired Mid-America Auto Parts. From 2003 to 2026, he held various operational roles within the Company’s North America segment, including District Manager, Vice President of the Central Region, and Vice President of the West Division. As part of the Company’s succession planning, in January 2026, Mr. Shaw was promoted to Senior Vice President of Operations of the Company’s North America segment.


**About LKQ Corporation**


LKQ Corporation ([www.lkqcorp.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=itWRW3kVXiK4Wtd_I5PydJWXB_qQZU1yssDo0kO2d6Hat6b1GhHZ3jkEepjEAE8gQweHYbpNeL4znojiwHZnJQ==) ) is a leading provider of alternative and specialty parts to repair and accessorize automobiles and other vehicles. LKQ has operations in North America, Europe and Taiwan. LKQ offers its customers a broad range of OEM recycled and aftermarket parts, replacement systems, components, equipment, and services to repair and accessorize automobiles, trucks, and recreational and performance vehicles.
